messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v3.6.0 -> 5% (na-west). warming 1 replica/az. release-notes: docs/releases/3.6.0.md
morgan-sre: noticing p95 jump on na-west auth path from ~180ms -> ~320ms in the last 4m. error rate still low but tail up.
lee-eng: can you paste the trace id or sample? wondering if it's kv-cache related on quant shards.
morgan-sre: sample: `trace=abc123 svc=auth shard=4 variant=quant p95=328ms`
sam-ops: option: THROTTLE to 1% and hold, or PIN na-west back to v3.5.9. which should we do?
tara-pm: we have a small partner test in 20m. prefer minimal user impact  throttle+monitor sounds ok.
lee-eng: agree with throttle. will investigate cache warmup but need stable traffic to reproduce.
morgan-sre: agreed. prefer HOLD at 1% for 10m and run focused telemetry. if 5xx or p95 worsens we'll pin.
deploy-bot: adjusting rollout: set percent -> 1% (requested). will report status at +10m.
tara-pm: marketing on hold for the partner test. thanks.
sam-ops: implemented soft throttle rule and added auto-fallback if p95>500ms for 2m.
morgan-sre: monitoring now. reconvene in 10.
